title: List the fields a check reads
statement: Take the text a check reads from an explicit list of the fields students see, not by excluding the rest.
detail: A content audit for Grade 3 reading lessons first chose the text to check with a block list, and tokenized audio file names and voice names leaked into its vocabulary report (`shadow/content-eval/README.md`). It now reads only the fields on an explicit list, puts prose that is never shown, such as rubrics and keys, on a separate list, and flags any new prose field in the schema until it is placed on one of them (`shadow/content-eval/SKILL.md`).

evidence.quote: A blacklist was tried first and leaked tokenized audio filenames and TTS voice names into the vocabulary report.
A new prose field in the schema must be added to `PROSE_KEYS`; `SCHEMA-UNREAD` flags it until it is.
A field that looks like prose but is never shown (rubrics, keys, `pronunciation`) goes in `NOT_PROSE`.
Extraction is a strict whitelist on purpose: a blacklist leaked tokenized audio filenames and TTS voice names into the vocabulary report.
